z-m-12-07.title: 1 m² i cm² ingani?
z-m-12-07.topic: Hukama pakati pezvikamu zvenzvimbo m² ne cm²
z-m-12-07.goal: Nzwisisa kuti nei hukama pakati pezvikamu zvehurefu (1 m = 100 cm) hahugoni kutakurirwa nyore kuzvikamu zvenzvimbo, gadzira marectangle akawanda ane nzvimbo ye1 m² uchishandisa cm, wobva watsanangura kuti munin'ina anzwisise.
z-m-12-07.material: Kirasi yaJiho inoda kugadzira kona yekuverenga ine nzvimbo chaiyo ye1 m² kudivi rimwe rekirasi. Jiho akati, "1 m i100 cm, saka 1 m² i100 cm²." Munin'ina wake Harin, ari mugiredhi 3, akazvinzwa ndokuvhiringidzika. Zvikamu zvehurefu cm ne m, uye zvikamu zvenzvimbo cm² ne m². (cm² inoverengwa se"square centimeter," uye m² inoverengwa se"square meter.")

z-m-12-07.prereq.2: Revo yezvikamu zvenzvimbo cm² ne m²
z-m-12-07.s.s1.prompt: Jiho akazvigadzirisa saizvi achifungidzira square rine mativi e1 m. Sarudza mutsara mumwe usina kururama.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.0: Maka mutsara wega wega sewuri kutaura nezve "hurefu" kana "nzvimbo."
z-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.1: Wana zvakananga nzvimbo yesquare rine divi re100 cm mu cm uye uienzanise nemhedziso yemhinduro.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.0: Fungidzira nzvimbo yakaita sesquare ine mativi e1 m.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.2: Nzvimbo yesquare i(divi)×(divi), saka 1 m × 1 m = 1 m².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.3: 1 m i100 cm, saka 1 m² i100 cm².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 4 hauna kururama. Kune hurefu, 1 m = 100 cm, asi kunzvimbo, 100 cm × 100 cm = 10000 cm². 100 cm² inongova nzvimbo yesquare rine mativi e10 cm.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kuita kona yekuverenga rectangle ine nzvimbo chaiyo ye1 m². Sarudza upamhi nehurefu mu cm uvaise. Upamhi nehurefu zvose nhamba dzakazara kubva pa40 cm kusvika pa250 cm, uye kuchinjana upamhi nehurefu kunoverengwa semuchimiro mumwe chete, saka uverenge kamwe chete. Wana michimiro 3 yakasiyana.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza upamhi, uye ufunge, uchichinja kuenda ku m, kuti hurefu hunofanira kuva hupi kuti upamhi × hurefu zvive 1 m².
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kumapeya awakawana, nyora chigadzirwa chaupamhi nehurefu uye uongorore kuti ose akaenzana.

z-m-12-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Iri pa40 cm kana kupfuura uye pa250 cm kana shoma.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Upamhi nehurefu zvinofanira kuva 40 cm kana kupfuura uye 250 cm kana shoma.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Nzvimbo haisi 1 m². Chinja upamhi nehurefu kuita m uvawanze.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.explain: Kana nzvimbo iri 1 m², ndi 10000 mu cm². 100×100, 50×200, 80×125, ne 40×250 zvose zvinosangana nemamiriro (kuchinjana upamhi nehurefu chimiro chimwe chete). Aya mapeya umo chigadzirwa chepamhi nehurefu chiri 10000.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangurira Harin zvakareruka kuti sei 1 m² iri 10000 cm², kwete 100 cm². Harin anoziva kuwanza nemagiridhi e cm, asi zvikamu zvenzvimbo itsva kwaari. Zvakanaka kunyora sokunge uri kudhirowa mufananidzo nemashoko.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.0: Edza kutanga wataura zvinozivikanwa naHarin kare (kuwanza, masikweya e 1 cm).
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira kuzadza sikweya ine mativi e 1 m nemasikweya e 1 cm, uye uverenge kuti masikweya mangani anokwana mutsetse mumwe uye kuti pane mitsetse mingani.

z-m-12-02.title: Tinogona kuvimba nenzira yaSeoa yekuderedza here?
z-m-12-02.topic: Kugadzira ma fractions ehukuru hwakaenzana nemutemo wekuderedza ma fractions
z-m-12-02.goal: Edza pfungwa yekuti "kuita chinhu chimwechete kudenominator nenumerator" kunochengeta hukuru hwakafanana, uye utsanangure kuti maoperations api anochengeta hukuru hwefraction nemamiriro akasarudzika apo nzira yaSeoa inoshanda.
z-m-12-02.material: Seoa akanyora basa rake rekuderedza 4/8 (masere mana). Kuderedza fraction kunoreva kuita denominator nenumerator diki uku hukuru hwefraction huchisara. Seoa anoziva kuti "kana ukaita chinhu chimwechete kudenominator nenumerator, hukuru hunosara." Ngatitsvage kana tichigona kuvimba nebasa raSeoa.
z-m-12-02.thinking.0: Kuedza kuti nzira i yakanaka here uchishandisa zvinozivikanwa
z-m-12-02.thinking.2: Kuwana mamiriro apo nzira inoshanda nenhamba
z-m-12-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva ma fractions ehukuru hwakaenzana (padanho regiredhi re5)
z-m-12-02.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuedza kana nzira yaSeoa ichigona kuvimbwa. Ungazviziva sei zvakanyatsojeka?
z-m-12-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti ndeipi fraction ingaita kuti mhedzisiro iwanikwe zviri nyore kana uchiedza nzira yaSeoa.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funga nzira yekushandisa nzira iyi pafraction ine hukuru hwaunoziva kare uye uenzanise mhedzisiro nehukuru hwekutanga.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.a: Dhonza 4/8 ne 2/6 semifananidzo uye utarise kana dzichiratidzika dzakaenzana muhukuru.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.a: Kuratidzika kufanana hakusi humbowo hwekuenzana. Misiyano midiki yakaoma kuona nemeso.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.b: Shandisa nzira iyi pa fraction 2/4 (hafu), iyo yaunoziva mhinduro yayo, uye utarise kana mutengo uchisara wakafanana.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i pfungwa yekuti kuti nzira i yakanaka here inogona kutariswa pakarepo nekuishandisa panzvimbo apo mhinduro inozivikanwa.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.c: Verenga zvakare 8-2 ne 4-2 kuti uone kana Seoa akabvisa zvakarurama.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.c: Kuverenga kwakarurama nenzira yakarurama zvinhu zvakasiyana.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.d: Sezvo akaita "chinhu chimwechete," nzira inofanira kuva yakarurama zvakare, saka enderera mberi.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.d: Kunyangwe ukaita chinhu chimwechete kudenominator nenumerator, mhedzisiro inogona kuchinja zvichienderana nekuti i kuwedzera, kubvisa, kuwanza, kana kupatsanura.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaedza nzira iyi pafraction yaunoziva mhinduro yayo, unogona kuziva pakarepo kana nzira ichichengeta hukuru. 2/4 i hafu (1/2), asi kana ukabvisa 1 nenzira imwechete, inova 1/3, uye hukuru hunochinja.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.prompt: Seoa akachinja 4/8 nenzira mbiri uye akanyora izvi. Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.hint.0: Siyanisa kuti mutsetse mumwe nemumwe unotaura mhedzisiro yekuverenga here kana unoti mhedzisiro mbiri dzakaenzana.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ita kuti 1/2 ne 2/6 dzive nedenominator imwechete, kana uzvichinje kuita ma decimals, uye uenzanise hukuru hwadzo zvakananga.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.line.0: Chinangwa: gadzira fraction yakaenzana muhukuru ne 4/8 asi ine denominator nenumerator diki.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.line.1: Nzira 가: Patsanura denominator nenumerator ne 4 imwechete → 1/2.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.line.2: Nzira 나: Bvisa 2 imwechete kubva kudenominator nenumerator → 2/6.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.line.3: Mu 가 ne 나 zvose, chinhu chimwechete chakaitwa kudenominator nenumerator, saka 1/2 ne 2/6 zvakaenzana muhukuru.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 4 ndiwo wekutanga usina kururama (mutsetse 5 i mhedzisiro yawo). "Kupatsanura nenhamba imwechete" kunochengeta hukuru, asi "kubvisa nhamba imwechete" hakuchengeti. 4/8 = 1/2 i yakarurama, asi 2/6 = 1/3, iyo i hukuru hwakasiyana ne 1/2. Mitsetse 2 ne 3 yakarurama sekuverenga.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.prompt: Pane fraction ine hukuru husingachinji kunyangwe ukashandisa nzira yaSeoa (kubvisa nhamba imwechete k kubva kudenominator nenumerator) here? Sarudza fraction a/b nenhamba k yekubvisa kuti (a−k)/(b−k) ive yakaenzana muhukuru ne a/b, uye utsvage mienzaniso 3 yakasiyana yekuisa. (a ne b i natural numbers kubva ku 2 kusvika ku 12, k i natural number kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 11, uye a ne b dzose dzinofanira kuva hombe kupfuura k.)
z-m-12-02.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza fraction imwe nenhamba imwe yekubvisa, verenga, uye uenzanise mutengo mushure mekubvisa nemutengo wekutanga nekuuchinja kuita ma decimals.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.hint.1: Unganidza mienzaniso yakabuda yakaenzana patafura uye uenzanise a ne b padivi pedivi.

z-m-12-01.s.s1.r.b: Kana ukangofunga nezvokureva sezvakagadzirwa, haupiwi mukana wokutsvaga zvisiri mutemo.

Kana ma fractions ese maviri ari madiki kupfuura 1, zvakaita sekutora "chikamu" che "chikamu chenhamba," saka mhedzisiro i diki kupfuura nhamba mbiri idzi.

z-m-12-06.topic: Kuenderana kwehuwandu huviri (nhamba yemapoka nenhamba yemitambo)
z-m-12-06.goal: Edza chirevo chekuti "kana mapoka akapetwa kaviri, mitambo inopetwa kaviri" nemuenzaniso unopokana, uye utsanangure nekuronga kuti ruzivo rupi runodiwa chaizvo kusarudza nhamba yemitambo uye rwupi husingadiwi.
z-m-12-06.material: Iyi mitemo yetouramenti yetug-of-war. Boka rinorohwa kamwe rinobuda, uye hapana kuenzana. Mapoka maviri anotamba mutambo mumwe. Boka risina mumwe wekutamba naye rinoenda kuchikamu chinotevera risina kutamba (bye), uye bye haiverengwi semutambo. Touramenti inopera kana boka rimwe chete ravhinga rasara. Zvimwe zvikoro zvinoita mutambo wechi3-wechi4 uye zvimwe hazvizviiti, uye kana chikoro chichiuita, mutambo iwoyo unoverengwa munhamba yemitambo. Nemapoka 2 pane mutambo 1, uye nemapoka 4 pane mitambo 3 (semi-finals 2, finari 1). Doyun akati, "Kana nhamba yemapoka ikapetwa kaviri, nhamba yemitambo inopetwawo kaviri."

z-m-12-08.s.s2.prompt: Jisu akawana kukonya kwechimiro chakasara seizvi. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe wakanganisa.

z-m-12-08.s.s2.line.2: Mushure merutivi rokumusoro, dzika 3 pamwe nechikamu chakagurwa, enda kurudyi 4, uye dzikazve 5 (=8−3), woguma wadzoka panzvimbo yawakatangira.
z-m-12-08.s.s2.line.3: Asi 3 ne 4 mativi anopinda mukati, saka abvise pakukonya. Saka kukonya ndi 10+8+6+5=29 (cm).
z-m-12-08.s.s2.line.4: Kukonya kwakava pfupi ne 7 cm kupfuura 36 cm yepakutanga.
z-m-12-08.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 4 wakanganisa (mutsetse 5 ndiwo mhedzisiro yawo). Rutivi runopinda mukati rwuri chikamu chomucheto wechimiro, saka runosanganisirwa mukukonya. 10+8+6+3+4+5=36 (cm), zvakafanana nepakutanga.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, pabepa rimwe chete (upamhi hwe 10 cm, hurefu hwe 8 cm), padyo nepakati porutivi rwokumusoro, uchisiya makona ose maviri, gura rectangle yakaita se notch ine upamhi hwe p cm nokudzika kwe q cm. Tsvaga ma notch 3 akasiyana kuti kukonya kuve kurefu nokuda kwe 8 cm kana kupfuura kupfuura kwepakutanga uye nzvimbo yakasara ive 50 cm² kana kupfuura, uye uaise. z-m-12-08.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza notch, enda kamwe kutenderera chimiro chakasara unyore kukonya, uye uchienzanise ne 36 cm.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora patafura kuti ndechipi chekukonya nenzvimbo yakasara chinochinja kana ukachinja q uye kana ukachinja p.

z-m-12-08.s.s3.ok.c2: p ne q ziri mukati momuganho.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.fail.c2: p inofanira kuva 1 kusvika 8, uye q inofanira kuva 1 kusvika 7.

z-m-12-08.s.s3.fail.c3: Kukonya hakuwedzeri ne 8 cm kana kupfuura. Tarisa kudzika kwe notch nokuchinja kwokukonya.

z-m-12-08.s.s3.fail.c4: Nzvimbo yakasara iri pasi pe 50 cm². Tarisa nzvimbo yakagurwa.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.explain: Kudzika q kwe notch kunosarudza kukonya (mativi maviri e notch anoonekwa patsva, saka kukonya kunowedzera ne 2×q cm), uye chigadzirwa chepamhi p nokudzika q kwe notch chinosarudza nzvimbo inopera. Semuenzaniso, kana p=6 uye q=4, nzvimbo yakasara i 80−24=56 cm² uye kukonya ndi 36+2×4=44 cm.

z-m-12-09.title: Kana tikabatanidza avhareji dzemapoka maviri, zvichava pakati chaipo here?

z-m-12-09.s.s1.r.a: Iyi pfungwa yakaona kuti zvibodzwa zveboka rine vadzidzi vakawanda zvinoverengwa zvakawanda.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.o.b: Ndi mapoinzi 75 chaizvo. Nokuti ndiyo pakati pemapoinzi 80 ne 70.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa mavhareji chete uye hauna kutarisa huwandu hwevanhu. Tarisa kana ichiri pakati kana huwandu hwevanhu huri husina kuenzana.

z-m-12-09.s.s1.r.c: Chokwadi kuti zvibodzwa zvidiki zvinodzikisa avhareji, asi wakakanganwa kuti boka iroro rine vanhu vashoma, saka mugumisiro waro uri mudiki.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.o.d: Hatigoni kuziva. Nokuti hatizivi chibodzwa chomudzidzi mumwe nomumwe.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.r.d: Kana uine avhareji yeboka nehuwandu hwevanhu, unogona kuwana huwandu hwezvibodzwa zveboka, saka avhareji yose yakagadzikana kunyange usingazivi zvibodzwa zvomunhu mumwe nomumwe.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.explain: Huwandu hwezvibodzwa zveboka 가 ndi 80×6=480 mapoinzi uye zveboka 나 ndi 70×4=280 mapoinzi, saka huwandu hwose ndi mapoinzi 760 evadzidzi 10, uye avhareji yose ndi mapoinzi 76. Iri padyo neavhareji yeboka rine vadzidzi vakawanda.

z-m-12-10.title: Kugadzira bhokisi remabhora: ndiyo nhamba imwe chete yemabhora inokodzera mamiriro here?
z-m-12-10.topic: Kuenzanisa kuti zvinhu zvinogona sei kuitika nokududzira mhedzisiro yeuedzo
z-m-12-10.goal: Sarudza huwandu hwemabhora nenzira dzakati wandei kuti zvikodzere mamiriro ekuti rimwe nerimwe rinogona sei kutorwa, uye utsanangure kuti haugoni kugumisa kuti kugadzira kwakanganisa nokuti mhedzisiro yeuedzo une kuedza kushoma yakasiyana nokugadzira.
z-m-12-10.material: Boka raMina rinoisa mabhora matsvuku, bhuruu, netsvuku-yero mubhokisi, rinopfumbira meso rotora bhora rimwe, rotarisa ruvara rwaro, rotodzorera. Mabhora akaenzana muhukuru nehuremu uye akasanganiswa zvakanaka, saka bhora rega rega rine mukana wakaenzana wokutorwa. Mamiriro okugadzira bhokisi ndeaya. Huwandu hwemabhora matsvuku huri nguva 3 chaizvo huwandu hwemabhora eyero. Huwandu hwemabhora bhuruu hwakaenzana kana hwakawanda kupfuura huwandu hwemabhora eyero, uye hwakadzika pahuwandu hwemabhora matsvuku. Isa bhora rimwe 1 kana kupfuura rerudzi rwoga rwoga rwemavara matatu, uye pane mabhora 10 kana kupfuura uye 24 kana shoma zvose.

z-m-12-10.thinking.2: Kurongedza pfungwa isiri yechokwadi yokuti mhedzisiro yakapfuura inochinja mukana unotevera
z-m-12-10.prereq.0: Kuenzanisa nemashoko kuti zvinogona sei kuitika (chiyero cheGredhi 5)
z-m-12-10.prereq.1: Ruvara rune mabhora akawanda rune mukana mukuru wokutorwa
z-m-12-10.s.s1.prompt: Gadzira zvigadziro 3 zvakasiyana zvebhokisi zvinosangana nemamiriro. Isa huwandu hwemabhora matsvuku, bhuruu, neyero.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kana wasarudza huwandu hwemabhora eyero, huwandu hwemabhora matsvuku hunogadzikana. Edza kuti mabhora eyero mangani anogona kuita kuti huwandu hwose huwe mukati momuganho.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.hint.1: Mushure mokusarudza huwandu hwematsvuku neyero, tarisa muganho wenhamba dzinogona kuva dzemabhora bhuruu, pakati penhamba mbiri idzi, uye uenzanise huwandu hwose.

z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c1: Ndapota isa nhamba yechisikigo ye 1 kana kupfuura kumavara ose matatu.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c2: Mabhora matsvuku ari nguva 3 yemabhora eyero.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c2: Huwandu hwemabhora matsvuku hahusi nguva 3 yehuwandu hwemabhora eyero.

z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c3: Huwandu hwemabhora bhuruu hunofanira kuva hwakaenzana kana hwakawanda kupfuura huwandu hwemabhora eyero uye mashoma pahuwandu hwemabhora matsvuku.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c4: Pane mabhora 10 kana kupfuura uye 24 kana shoma zvose.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c4: Huwandu hwose hwemabhora hauri pakati pe 10 ne 24. Chinja huwandu hwemabhora eyero uone huwandu hwose.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.explain: Kuva nemabhora eyero 2, 3, kana 4 kunogoneka. Semuenzaniso, (tsvuku, bhuruu, yero) = (6, 2, 2) ine huwandu hwose hwe 10, uye 6=3×2, 2≥2, 2<6. (6, 5, 2), (9, 4, 3), ne (12, 6, 4) zvinoshandawo. Kana pane eyero 1, huwandu hwose hunoshayiwa pa 10, uye kana pane 5 kana kupfuura, hunopfuura 24.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.prompt: Mina akagadzira bhokisi rine mabhora matsvuku 6, bhuruu 2, neyero 2 akatora kakapetwa ka 10, akawana tsvuku ka 5, yero ka 3, uye bhuruu ka 2. Nokuti tsvuku haisi nguva 3 yeyero, Mina anofunga kuti kugadzira kwakanganisa. Nzira yakanakisa yokuzvitarisa ndeipi?
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.0: Isa mhedzisiro yokutora kwe 10 padivi penhamba dziri mubhokisi (6, 2, 2) uye utaure zvakafanana nezvakasiyana.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana kutora kwe 10 zvakare kubva mubhokisi rimwe chete kuchipa mhedzisiro yakafanana chaizvo, uye uenzanise mhedzisiro yezvikamu zviviri.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.a: Kugadzira kwakanganisa. Kana pane mabhora 6, 2, 2, huwandu hwenguva dzakatorwa hunofanira kuva 6, 2, 2 zvakare.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.a: Wakafunga kuti reshiyo yehuwandu hwemabhora inofanira kuonekwa chaizvo sezvayakaita muhuwandu hwenguva dzakatorwa.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.b: Kugadzira kwakarurama. Nokuti yero yakabuda shoma, yero ine mukana mukuru wokubuda nguva inotevera.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.b: Kana ukadzorera mabhora uchiwasanganisa, mhedzisiro yakapfuura haichinji mukana unotevera, asi wakafunga kuti inochinja.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.c: Kutora kwe 10 huwandu hudiki, saka kunogona kusiyana. Wedzera huwandu hwokutora, ita kakawanda, uye uenzanise.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.c: Iyi pfungwa yokuona kuti mhedzisiro yokuedza kushoma inogona kuzunguzwa nechokwadi chinoitika, uye kuedza kutarisa nokuwedzera huwandu hwokuedza.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.d: Tsvuku yakabuda zvakawanda zvikuru, saka zvakaratidzwa kuti kugadzira kwakarurama.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.d: Wakasimbisa kuti kugadzira kwakarurama kubva pamhedzisiro yeuedzo humwe chete.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.explain: Mukana wetsvuku kuva nguva 3 weyero unoreva kuti mukana wokutorwa uri nguva 3, kwete kuti inobuda nguva 3 chaizvo (ka 6 ne ka 2) mukutora kwe 10. Nokuedza kushoma, inogona kusiyana nechokwadi chinoitika, uye kuedza kwakawanda, kunowanzo swedera kureshiyo yehuwandu hwemabhora. Tsvuku ka 5 neyero ka 3 mhedzisiro inogona kuitika zvakanaka.
